components.css: .ds-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;padding:14px;background:#111915;font-family:var(--font-display,'Overpass Variable',sans-serif)}.ds-seg{position:relative;min-height:72px;display:grid;align-content:center;padding:12px 16px;color:#e8eee9;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-seg.n{background:color-mix(in srgb,#1f8a4c 32%,#111915)}.ds-seg.f{background:color-mix(in srgb,#d3302a 32%,#111915)}.ds-seg.w{background:color-mix(in srgb,#f2a900 32%,#111915)}.ds-seg.w.cur{background:#f2a900;color:#111915}.ds-ptr{position:absolute;top:-14px;left:50%;width:0;height:0;border-top:14px solid #fff;border-left:12px solid transparent;border-right:12px solid transparent;transform:translateX(-50%)}

narrative.overview: PyroGuard reads like a roadside fire-danger rating sign. Risk is a three-class scale (NORMAL, ADVERTENCIA, INCENDIO) with a pointer over the current class, drawn as a black signal block with enamel-saturated segments. The scale is the signature: it appears once large at the top of the summary and again in miniature on every node card. The surrounding chrome is conifer green, flat panels carry a thick black border, and there are no diffuse shadows or gradients. The mood is calm when everything is normal and unmistakable in fire, when the whole rail turns to a red field.
keyCharacteristics: Three-class scale with pointer, big band globally and 3-segment mini per node.
Flat panels, 2px black border, 2px corners, no soft shadows.
Overpass uppercase for labels and big numbers; system-ui for body.
Global risk tints the rail through body[data-risk] in WARNING and FIRE.
Every state has a non-color cue (icon, notch, dash, stamp).

rules.name: The Enamel Reserve Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean risk class and nothing else. Decorative use of them dilutes the sign.

rules.name: The Rail Field Rule
rules.body: Only body[data-risk] changes the rail color, and only for WARNING and FIRE; NORMAL leaves the conifer.

rules.name: The Sign Voice Rule
rules.body: Overpass is for labels, headings and numbers; paragraphs stay in system-ui.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: No diffuse shadows or gradients on app surfaces.

dos: Do express risk as the three-class scale and repeat it per node in miniature.
Do pair every color state with a shape cue: icon, notch, dash, or stamp.
Do keep panels flat: 2px signal-ink border, 2px radius.
Do tint the rail only through body[data-risk] for WARNING and FIRE.
Do keep 44px minimum targets and the 3px focus-blue ring.
Do show a CERRADA stamp for closed items instead of hiding them.
donts: Don't return to a grid of identical metric cards with a colored side border.
Don't use green, amber or red for anything but risk class.
Don't add blur shadows, gradients or radii above 2px to new surfaces.
Don't set long paragraphs in Overpass.
Don't signal state by color alone.
